units.source_text: 次日清晨，宇治山庄中不见了浮舟，

en.t: The next morning, Ukifune was nowhere to be seen at the Uji villa,

units.source_text: 众侍女惊恐万状，东寻西找，终于不明下落。

en.t: and all the serving women were terrified, searching everywhere, but in the end they could not discover where she had gone.

units.source_text: 这正像小说中千金小姐被劫后次晨的光景，不须详述。

en.t: It was just like the morning after a noble young lady has been abducted in a tale, and there is no need to describe it in detail.

units.source_text: 京中母夫人的使者昨日不曾归去，母夫人不放心，今天又派一个使者来。

en.t: The messenger from her mother in the capital had not returned the day before, and her anxious mother sent another messenger today.

units.source_text: 这使者说：“鸡鸣时分我就奉命出发了。”

en.t: This messenger said, "I was ordered to set out at cockcrow."

units.source_text: 从乳母以至众侍女，个个周章狼狈，困惑万状，不知该如何作答。

en.t: From the nurse down to all the serving women, everyone was flustered and distressed, utterly bewildered and not knowing how to answer.

units.source_text: 乳母等不知底细的人，只管惊惶骚扰。

en.t: Those who knew nothing of the truth, such as the nurse, could only panic and make a commotion.

units.source_text: 知道内情的右近和侍从，回想起浮舟近日忧愁苦闷之状，猜想她恐已投身赴水。

en.t: Ukon and Jiju, who knew the circumstances, recalled Ukifune's recent grief and anguish and feared that she might have thrown herself into the water.

units.source_text: 右近啼啼哭哭地打开母夫人的信来，但见信中写道：“恐是我为你操心太甚，

en.t: Ukon opened the mother's letter in tears, and saw that it said, "Perhaps because I have worried far too much about you,

units.source_text: 不能安枕之故，昨夜在梦中也不能清楚地看见你。

en.t: and could not sleep peacefully, last night I could not see you clearly even in my dreams.

units.source_text: 一合眼就被梦魇住。因此今天心情异常恶劣，念念不忘地惦记你。

en.t: As soon as I closed my eyes, nightmares seized me. So today I feel terribly uneasy and cannot stop thinking of you.

units.source_text: 薰大将迎你入京之期已近，我想在这以前先迎接你到我这里。

en.t: The time when General Kaoru is to bring you to the capital is drawing near, and before that I would like to bring you first to my place.

units.source_text: 但今日天雨，容后再定。”

en.t: But it is raining today, so let us decide again later."

units.source_text: 右近再打开浮舟昨夜答复母亲的信来看看，读了那两首诗，号啕大哭起来。

en.t: Ukon then opened the letter Ukifune had written in reply to her mother the night before, and when she read the two poems, she began to sob aloud.

units.source_text: 她想：“果然不出我之所料！这诗中的话多么伤心啊！

en.t: She thought, "It was just as I feared. How heartbreaking the words of these poems are.

units.source_text: 小姐下此决心，为何绝不让我知道呢？

en.t: Why did my lady make such a decision and never let me know?

units.source_text: 她从小万事都信任我，对我无话不谈。

en.t: Ever since she was small, she trusted me in everything and told me whatever was on her mind.

units.source_text: 我也对她毫无隐讳。今当永别之时，她竟遗弃了我，

en.t: I too hid nothing from her. Yet now, at the time of our final parting, she has abandoned me,

units.source_text: 绝不向我透露一点风声，真叫我好恨啊！”

en.t: without giving me the slightest hint. How bitterly I resent it."

units.source_text: 她捶胸顿足地大哭，竟像一个幼年的孩童。

en.t: She beat her breast and stamped her feet as she wept, just like a small child.

units.source_text: 浮舟忧愁苦闷之状，她早已看惯。

en.t: She had long been used to seeing Ukifune sunk in sorrow and distress.

units.source_text: 然而这位小姐性情一向温顺，她万万想不到她会走上这条绝路。

en.t: But this young lady had always been gentle by nature, and she never imagined she would take such a desperate path.

units.source_text: 因此骇怪万状，悲痛不已。

en.t: For that reason she was shocked beyond measure and overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 乳母平日自作聪明，今天却呆若木鸡，嘴里只管念着“怎么办呢？怎么办呢？”

en.t: The nurse, who usually fancied herself clever, stood today as if stunned, merely repeating under her breath, "What shall we do? What shall we do?"
